description: The plot illustrates loss ratio (in percent) as a function of compute measured in TFLOPs for five methods/variants. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a logarithmic scale, and spans from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels shown at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100 with integer tick marks. The “Vanilla” series is a purple solid line with triangle markers that stays flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=64)” is an orange solid line with plus markers that starts around 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 100.0% by 2e8, peaks near 100.4% at 4e8, and ends around 99.9% at 9e8 with small fluctuations near 100% in the upper TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=128)” is a blue solid line with x markers that begins near 97.0% at 1e7, increases to about 99.9% by 4e8–5e8, then remains close to 99.8–99.9% through 9e8 with a slight dip around 8e8 (about 99.7%). “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is a green solid line with diamond markers that starts near 97.5% at 1e7, climbs to about 100.0% by 4e8–5e8, reaches about 100.2% at 6e8, and finishes near 99.8% at 9e8 while staying close to 100% from roughly 2e8 onward. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is a red solid line with circle markers that begins at about 94.0% at 1e7, rises to roughly 97.2% at 5e7 and about 98.5% at 2e8, reaches around 99.1% at 4e8, dips to about 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends near 98.7% at 9e8.
